highlights.description: Initial release: ResourceRef, a canonical and comparable RFC 3986 resource reference that passes owner-canonical URIs (ARN, SPIFFE, HTTPS, URN) through untouched, and the scheme engine for defining owned URI schemes as data

added.description: Stdlib-only module scaffolding with Go CI, lint and CodeQL workflows, under the Apache-2.0 license

ResourceRef: Parse, String, Equal and text/JSON marshaling as a plain string, with conservative RFC 3986 canonicalization (case, percent-encoding, dot segments), an external-URI passthrough corpus and fuzz tests for canonical-form idempotence

scheme.Profile format and Load: URI subset constraints, authority registry, path shapes, resource-type registries and version/alias grammar, with a JSON Schema generated from the Go types and embedded in the schema package
Profile.Validate and Profile.Split: match a ResourceRef against a profile and return its typed Parts (authority, app, org, resourceType, id, version), with a reference test profile and golden corpus

documentation.description: docs/embedding.md: how to add a resource-reference field to an IR, in Go and in hand-written or generated JSON Schema, and how to keep logical and instance identity apart
README, package docs and specs use neutral placeholder names in every example
